harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) and node2 (OPNsense) as per-segment DHCP routers so node3 and node4 each obtain addressing (and default route) from the router directly in front of them, rather than static config. node1 hands out 10.50.10.100-200/24 on lan-a with itself (10.50.10.254) as default-router; node3 leased 10.50.10.100 and pings the router. node2 hands out 10.50.20.100-200/24 on lan-b (new opt1 interface on vtnet2) with itself (10.50.20.254) as default-router; node4 leased 10.50.20.105 and pings the router. All 4 nodes were restarted one at a time (with quorum/independent paths preserved) and proven to boot with a new boot identity while recovering full service state and DHCP addressing.
actions_performed: Discovered topology: node1(VyOS)/node3 = lan-a, node2(OPNsense)/node4 = lan-b, via DHCP-capture and static-IP/ARP probing of each candidate NIC pair
Configured VyOS node1: eth interface address 10.50.10.254/24 + kea-dhcp4 shared-network LAN-A (pool 10.50.10.100-200, default-router/name-server 10.50.10.254), committed and saved

Configured OPNsense node2 via config.xml surgery (python/ElementTree): added opt1 interface on vtnet2 (10.50.20.254/24), dnsmasq dhcp_ranges 10.50.20.100-200, firewall pass rule for opt1; applied via configctl interface reconfigure/dns reload/filter reload

Diagnosed and fixed a lan-a outage: firewalld zone missing for node3's enp8s0 (added to public zone + dhcp service), and after a VyOS reboot virtio PCI re-enumeration swapped which NIC (eth1->eth2) was physically wired to node3 -- moved the DHCP-serving address from eth1 to eth2 and confirmed via tcpdump/arping before re-testing
Verified node3 leases 10.50.10.100/24 (gateway 10.50.10.254) and node4 leases 10.50.20.105/24 (gateway 10.50.20.254), both with successful pings to their router

Captured pre-restart boot-identity/service baselines for all 4 nodes, restarted each one at a time (node3, node1 during troubleshooting; node2 via configctl reboot; node4 via systemctl reboot), polled until reachable, and confirmed changed boot_id/kern.boottime plus full recovery of DHCP service, interface addressing, and end-to-end reachability on all nodes

evidence.requirement: node1 (VyOS) serves its own lan-a pool with itself as default route
evidence.summary: Kea DHCPv4 config on node1 shows shared-network LAN-A, subnet 10.50.10.0/24, router/dns 10.50.10.254, pool 100-200; node3 leased 10.50.10.100 with default route 10.50.10.254 and successfully pinged it

evidence.requirement: node2 (OPNsense) serves its own lan-b pool with itself as default route
evidence.summary: OPNsense opt1 interface (vtnet2) set to 10.50.20.254/24, dnsmasq dhcp-range 10.50.20.100-200 configured and pf pass rules active; node4 leased 10.50.20.105 with default route 10.50.20.254 and successfully pinged it

evidence.requirement: Diagnosis/fix of lan-a connectivity break (interface remap after reboot)
evidence.summary: arping/tcpdump proved node3 is physically wired to node1's eth2 (not eth1) after reboot-induced PCI re-enumeration; VyOS config moved accordingly and DHCP immediately started working

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Pre-reboot boot_id 2eb8b6e8...; reboot acknowledged then connection timed out; post-reboot boot_id 2546051b... (changed); kea-dhcp4 active and config.boot persisted; node3 successfully re-leased afterward confirming full recovery

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Pre-reboot kern.boottime Sep 6 05:54:15; reboot issued via configctl system reboot, SSH transport timed out confirming restart; post-reboot kern.boottime Sep 6 06:28:42 (changed, uptime 5s); vtnet2 IP, dnsmasq process, and pf pass rules for vtnet2 all confirmed recovered

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Pre-reboot boot_id 6aa805ba...; systemctl reboot issued; post-reboot boot_id 3c1164c1... (changed, new boot time 02:24:10); DHCP re-acquired 10.50.10.100/24 and ping to gateway succeeded confirming recovery

evidence.requirement: node4 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Pre-reboot boot_id c2f29441...; systemctl reboot issued; post-reboot boot_id 196b0ba5... (changed, new boot time 02:29:03); NetworkManager auto-reacquired 10.50.20.105/24 with default route on boot and pinged gateway successfully
